summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only regression + role split + rename testing. All 15 requested test areas verified. DialyGo branding present, no 'Dialyso' string anywhere in /app/frontend/src. Five-role login selector renders (operator/doctor/patient/dialysisadmin/techadmin). Operator (OPR-1041), Doctor (DOC-0071), Dialysis Admin (ADM-0002 -> /clinical-admin/home with 7 modules + Future Roadmap), and Technical Admin (ADM-0001 -> /tech-admin/home with 7 modules + Future Roadmap) all land correctly. Patient two-step OTP flow (login-otp-input, mock 123456) lands on /patient/home. Role isolation verified both directions: dialysisadmin hitting /tech-admin/users redirects to /clinical-admin/home and techadmin hitting /clinical-admin/patients redirects to /tech-admin/home. Legacy /admin/* paths redirect via wildcard back to login/role home (not blank). Profile menu exposes all 5 switch-role-* items and swaps sidebar+landing. Regressions unchanged: pre-session shows 7 checklist checkboxes, run-core-engine-btn completes, machine-insights shows withheld-until-clinician-sign-off text before approval, doctor approve-btn works. Tech-admin settings has 6 switches with 3 disabled (future release). Mobile viewport 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow on login, operator home, pre-session, dialysis-admin home, tech-admin home; mobile menu opens with navy sidebar and white DialyGo wordmark (Go in saffron). Invalid operator ID and unticked-consent errors still fire.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js hardcodes demo IDs (demoIds constant) - fine for a mock prototype but should be centralised with AppContext demoUsers if this grows.
AdminPages.js aggregates both Technical Admin and Dialysis Admin views in a single module - consider splitting once functional divergence increases.
Wildcard <Route path='*'> redirects to '/' which then bounces to role home - works but a 404-aware component might help future navigation debugging.
test_credentials: Operator OPR-1041, Doctor DOC-0071, Patient DUR-PT-00218 (mock OTP 123456), Dialysis Admin ADM-0002, Technical Admin ADM-0001; DPDP consent required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prototype is frontend-only; state resets on full page reload. Patient login is TWO clicks on login-submit-btn (first sends OTP, then verify 123456). Profile menu trigger data-testid is 'profile-menu-btn' (not profile-menu-trigger). Settings page has 6 role/feature switches; the 3 future-release toggles are correctly disabled. Iteration 3 is a clean pass; only cosmetic/architectural code-review comments remain.
